explanation: A person who acts in accordance with moral principles and maintains a good character.
Difficult situations or sufferings that some experience, often to test their faith or character.
To express dissatisfaction, pain, or suffering, usually toward God, especially in the context of trials.
Support, encouragement, or help given to someone who is suffering or going through difficulties.
The ability to use knowledge and experience in a sensible way to make good decisions and act rightly.
The manner in which God governs the world and human lives, including his plans and purposes.
